title: Merchandise Value Share on Freight Service-Failure Refunds - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
On a Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders purchase shipped by Large Item Freight Delivery, the service-failure refund on the freight fee carries an item-value share that depends on the merchandise billed on the order - the total amount billed on the order's line charges.

**Rule.** The item-value share is 8% where the merchandise billed is $300.00 or more, 4% where it is at least $150.00 but below $300.00, and nothing below $150.00. The item-value share is added to the service-failure share, and the summed share is what the freight fee is multiplied by.

| Merchandise billed on the order's line charges | Item-value share added |
|---|---|
| $300.00 or more | 8% |
| $150.00 to $299.99 | 4% |
| Below $150.00 | Nothing |

### Boundary cases

| Merchandise billed | Item-value share |
|---|---|
| $149.99 | Nothing |
| $150.00 | 4% |
| $299.99 | 4% |
| $300.00 | 8% |

**What counts as merchandise billed.** Only the line charges count, at the amount billed on them (after any allocated coupon or certificate); the freight fee, redelivery fees and any refunds are not part of it.

**Example (hypothetical).** A freight order with one line charge billed at $389.00 adds an item-value share of 8%; a starting share of 30% would become 38% before the freight fee is multiplied by it.
